title: Review of c50's Marangoni spread loop 2 on fresh seed 521 (fast discs, escape arm and identical-event twin): fast discs do not reward distance (M-gate passers 4/15 vs 3/22); the trait mean direction under fast discs is seed noise (E 36.9 vs twin 30.0 here, twin above E on seed 501)
summary: Labkit runs of loop 1's world.py on seed 521, 128^2, 400 frames, with the loop-2 fast discs (disc_v 0.16): escape arm Efast (ARM S) and identical-event twin (MARS 40/40/40), read with c00's extract.py and c50's spread_stats.py. Efast: trait mean 40.0 (frame 61), 42.7, then the mar-60 kind is lost by frame 242 and k0 rises (31.4), 36.9 at the end; 15 dividing tracks, 4 pass the M gate in rod lengths (k0 2/4, k1 2/10, k2 0/1), 10 by sqrt(area); 12 mutations, 0 conversions, 1 off-kind of 70. Twin: 38.9, 41.7, 35.7, 30.0 at the end; 22 dividing, 3 pass (k1 3/10); 13 mutations, 1 conversion, 2 off-kind of 62.

observations.M: Efast_s521.txt vs twinfast_s521.txt: passers 4/15 vs 3/22 under fast discs (no clear reward for distance); trait mean at T=2000 36.9 vs 30.0, but in both arms the mar-60 kind is lost by t~1200

seeds_run.result: pass for the fast-disc negative; the sign of the fast-disc trait-mean difference is opposite to seed 501's

controls_run.M: rerun/twinfast (identical-event twin, same seed and mutation uniforms)

not_checked: slow-disc arms on a new seed (my loop-1 review, seed 520, covers them)
C and drive-off under fast discs
verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed and 13-24 bodies per arm. As the finding says, single lineages decide each curve: here a k1 -> k0 drift drives both arms below 40, so the fast-disc trait mean says nothing about selection either way.
